title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.16977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems are increasingly capable of contributing to mathematical research. In research practice, frontier-model reasoning is a limited resource, and expert mathematical review is even more sharply constrained. Allocating these scarce resources well is therefore central to making AI-assisted mathematical discovery efficient. In most current AI-for-math workflows, human effort is concentrated at the beginning and end, in selecting suitable research problems and later reviewing the resulting artifacts. These two stages are becoming bottlenecks for research-level mathematics. We address them by proposing a new human-AI discovery paradigm. The human input is no longer a single problem selected in advance, but a research direction in which the experts have interest and expertise. translated_title: 问题本身才是问题：迈向可扩展的数学发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16977v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能系统在数学研究中的贡献能力日益增强。在研究实践中，前沿模型的推理能力是一种有限资源，而专家级的数学审查则更为稀缺。因此，合理分配这些稀缺资源对于实现高效的AI辅助数学发现至关重要。在目前大多数AI用于数学的工作流程中，人类精力集中在开始和结束阶段，即选择合适的研究问题以及随后审查产生的成果。这两个阶段正成为研究级数学的瓶颈。我们通过提出一种新的人机协作发现范式来解决这些问题。人类输入不再是预先选定的单一问题，而是专家感兴趣且具备专长的研究方向。随后，系统在该方向上搜索广泛的文献语料库，以寻找候选问题。受搜索和推荐系统的启发，我们构建了“查找、尝试”系统。
tldr: 本文提出一种新的人机协作数学发现范式，将人类输入从单一问题转变为研究方向，并通过系统搜索文献自动生成候选问题，以解决AI辅助数学发现中问题选择和结果审查的瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new human-AI discovery paradigm that shifts human input from a single problem to a research direction, with the system automatically searching literature for candidate problems, to address bottlenecks in problem selection and result review in AI-assisted mathematical discovery.
